entities.summary: Franz San Galli was a prominent Russian public figure, entrepreneur and inventor. In 1882, San Galli was granted the status of a purveyor to the Russian Imperial Court and a right to apply the Imperial Coat of Arms to his products in recognition of their exceptional quality.
